name: The Requirements To Follow Jesus
overview: Following Jesus requires a decisive commitment demonstrated by self-denial, daily cross-bearing, and unwavering obedience, as Jesus instructs in Matthew 16:24 and Luke 9:23. This journey begins with repentance and baptism for the forgiveness of sins, accompanied by receiving the Holy Spirit, as Peter teaches in Acts 2:38. Belief in Jesus as God's Son secures eternal life (John 3:16), and living as His followers means dedicating all actions and words to His name with gratitude, reflecting the call found in Colossians 3:17. Paul’s example in Romans 1:1 highlights a life set apart and devoted to the gospel of God through Jesus Christ.
